style.name: Synthwave
style.description: Synthwave visuals draw on imagined 1980s futures, electronic music, and cinematic neon landscapes. Horizon grids, glowing suns, and purple-pink gradients create a nostalgic, night-driving atmosphere.

fonts.heading: Space Grotesk
fonts.rationale: Geometric headings and monospaced details convey retro technology without reducing readability to novelty lettering.

tips: Use the horizon as a visual focal point.
Apply glow to decoration rather than body copy.
Let dark areas provide resting space.

recipe.composition: Set a horizon-like visual behind a clear foreground panel; use a limited pink-violet spectrum.
recipe.motion: Static horizons preserve the mood; keep interaction feedback brief and avoid flashing neon.
recipe.signature: Retro-futurist horizons, luminous accent lines, and cinematic contrast.
